definitionZh: 导航抽屉组件包含应用程序的内部导航链接，可以永久显示在屏幕上或以编程方式进行控制。
sourceDefinition: The navigation drawer component contains internal navigation links for an application and can be permanently on-screen or controlled programmatically.
